findings.issue: Multiple attempts to inspect a crop of a tall reference PNG (img.screenshot clip, viewport-fit tricks) before landing on the canvas→dataURL approach
findings.suggestion: Reach directly for the canvas/dataURL crop, or load the PNG through a served page at natural size, when the built-in image viewer scales it down

findings.issue: Three failed attempts to install Pillow in an environment with no pip before switching to the already-available Playwright
findings.suggestion: Probe the environment's capabilities (which pip, which convert) before committing to a toolchain for throwaway analysis

findings.issue: Edits attempted against file content that was already correct, because it was editing from memory of its own write
findings.suggestion: Grep or re-read the target region before editing a file it just wrote

findings.issue: `pkill -f 'server.mjs'` matched the invoking shell's own command line (exit 143), then the same mistake was repeated with a broader pattern
findings.suggestion: Use a port-based kill (fuser/lsof) or a pattern that can't self-match

findings.issue: ~13 turns of pixel forensics on hero geometry when the spec only asks for a close match
findings.suggestion: Acceptable over-investment here since it caught a real structural mismatch, but a quicker look-then-adjust loop would be more proportionate

summary: A disciplined, front-loaded session: the agent read the spec, tests, fixtures and every reference screenshot before writing code, then passed the full 54-test suite on its first run with zero fix cycles. It then spent the remainder of the session on a genuinely proportionate visual pass against the reference screenshots, which caught and fixed one real structural error, and re-ran the full suite after the final edit. The only blemishes are a few short tooling dead ends (Pillow, image cropping, self-killing pkill) and two edit misses that cost a handful of turns.
